label: Current Events
title: A Letter to Gen Z
hook: We already agree on the wars, the foreign-interest money, and the price of a decent life. The culture war is what keeps us from acting on it. After November, we stop fighting each other and start primarying the warhawks in both parties.

label: Current Events
title: Why Republicans Are Really Going to Lose
hook: The party's loudest voices are blaming Muslims and antisemitism. The real reasons are a war they promised not to start, billions for the president's family, Epstein files they swore to release, and a coalition they threw away.

label: Investigation
title: The Best Investment in Washington Is a Seat in Congress
hook: The STOCK Act passed almost unanimously in 2012. A year later, Congress quietly gutted it. Fourteen years, one $200 fine, and one pardoned felon later, both parties are still trading in the industries they regulate.
